setting.descriptionLanguage: Language for catalog documentation. Auto follows the editor; unsupported languages fall back to English.
setting.completionMode: Normal hides symbols flagged hidden, developmentonly or internal. Advanced includes them. Both modes recognize all indexed symbols.
setting.parameterValidation: Warn about values outside evidenced ranges or reviewed parameter types and choices. This does not verify your installed game build.
setting.bindDiagnostics: Report repeated or replaced binds in a resolved execution sequence. Replacements may be intentional; unknown effects interrupt comparison. The health report includes these findings even when editor notices are off.
setting.inlayHints: Show reviewed parameter meanings next to literal values. Disabled by default.
setting.showOriginal: Also display the original English description when available.
setting.hoverDetails: Standard shows usage, parameter meanings and sources. Advanced also includes technical types and field provenance.
setting.cfgRoot: Optional absolute CFG directory used to resolve exec references. Otherwise use the current file's directory.
setting.consoleEvidence: Optional console evidence profile. The user report marks four crosshair commands rejected in an unidentified build; it is not a global removal claim.
setting.unknownCommands: Severity for commands missing from this incomplete community catalog.
setting.maxBlankLines: Maximum consecutive blank lines kept by the CFG formatter.
setting.separateSections: Add a blank line before separator comment headers.
setting.insertFinalNewline: End formatted documents with a newline.
